meta.name: alterlab-pydeseq2
meta.description: Run differential gene expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq count matrices with PyDESeq2, the Python port of DESeq2 — size-factor normalization, dispersion estimation, Wald tests, FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) correction, and volcano/MA plots. Use when identifying differentially expressed genes between conditions from raw bulk RNA-seq counts. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 对批量RNA-seq计数矩阵进行差异表达基因分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析批量RNA-seq数据，需要找出不同条件下的差异表达基因
copy.tagline_en: Run differential gene expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq count matrices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing bulk RNA-seq data and need to identify differentially expressed genes between conditions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能对批量 RNA-seq 计数数据做差异表达分析：计算大小因子、估计离散度、执行 Wald 检验、Benjamini-Hochberg 多重检验校正，并生成火山图和 MA 图。
howto.when: 当用户提供批量 RNA-seq 计数矩阵和实验条件（如处理组 vs 对照组），或提到“DESeq2”“差异表达”“RNA-seq 分析”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 RNA-seq 计数文件，比较处理组和对照组。
say.note: Claude 会加载数据并运行差异表达分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run differential expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq count matrices: compute size factors, estimate dispersions, perform Wald tests, Benjamini-Hochberg multiple testing correction, and generate volcano/MA plots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides bulk RNA-seq count matrices with experimental conditions (e.g., treated vs control), or mentions keywords like "DESeq2", "differential expression", or "RNA-seq analysis".

say_en.text: Analyze this RNA-seq count file, comparing treated vs control groups.
say_en.note: Claude will load data and run differential expression analysis.

say_en.text: Run differential gene analysis on this data using PyDESeq2 with design formula ~condition.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the full pipeline with the specified design.
